name: Macnica Anstek Inc.
summary: Macnica Anstek Inc. is a technology-oriented distributor of semiconductor ICs and embedded solutions in Taiwan. The company has evolved from a traditional distributor into a solutions partner with system integration expertise, focusing on AI, industrial automation, defense & aerospace, and smart IoT. Its major authorized brands include ADI, AMD, and ITE Tech, with products applied in industrial computers, wireless products, and automotive electronics. The company provides services ranging from high-end electronic component distribution to system integration support.
